messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining your position.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09). Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 85.0% (sc:70620@2026Q3).

We have analysed the cost situation of this part carefully; the options below reflect that analysis.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.49 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 4.43 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 4.45 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We look forward to your view on these options.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your feedback and the proposed options. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

As an alternative, we are prepared to extend the contract to 24 months with 30 days net payment terms, for which we can offer a revised price of €4.88 per unit. This option brings you a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for offering a lower price for faster payment. We understand that the verified delivery and volume information does not change your calculation, and that your price concession depends on the payment terms.

We are making a modest price step and offering a compromise on your requested faster payment in exchange for further price movement from you. We are flexible on contract length: Option A retains the term you proposed, while Option B offers a longer commitment to support planning; please indicate which works best.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.47 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 45 days net.
Option B: EUR 4.47 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 45 days net.

We appreciate your consideration of these straightforward packages and look forward to your response.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We truly appreciate your business and look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We appreciate your flexibility and are pleased to offer a revised price of €4.89 per unit for a 36-month agreement. Regarding your question, a longer contract length of 36 months allows us to make this price concession. Could you provide an indication of the volume you anticipate over this extended period? Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Currently, our offer is a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
